desc:
🤖 These Robots look WAY too strong… can yours defeat them?

🥊 Train your robot on punching bags to gain strength
💥 Battle and defeat other robots
🎲 Roll for rare gloves to gain more strength per punch
✨ Enchant your gloves to train even faster
🔄 Rebirth to become insanely powerful
🌎 Travel further to challenge tougher robots

Train your robot, build its power, and reach the end of the map!

👍 Like and favorite the game if you enjoy it!
